target_audience: Non-technical community organizers, teachers in LatAm

spacing_and_layout.general: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8, p-12. Avoid cramped data views.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: Tactile and friendly. Use rounded-2xl for cards, rounded-xl for buttons and inputs.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Bento style 'Control Room' for organizers. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6.
spacing_and_layout.surfaces: Neumorphism 'Clay & Crisp'. White surfaces with shadow-sm and 1px border-slate-100 to ground them. Interactive cards lift on hover (-translate-y-1, shadow-md).

components.buttons: Chunky, touch-friendly. Minimum h-12. Primary buttons use bg-sky-500 text-white shadow-sm. Use subtle scaling on active (active:scale-95).
components.timeline_editor: Spotify-style drag & drop. Use horizontal scrollable lanes (canchas) with discrete draggable 'pills' (partidos). The pills should be colorful (e.g., bg-sky-100 text-sky-900 border border-sky-200) with rounded-full or rounded-xl.
components.cards: Minimalist white boxes with soft styling. Internal padding p-6 or p-8.
components.forms: Use Shadcn UI inputs but customize with rounded-xl, h-12, and clear focus rings (focus:ring-sky-500).

hero_background.description: Aerial view of a white and red volleyball court
hero_background.usage: Use in the landing page hero section with a heavy sky-blue gradient overlay (bg-sky-900/80 or similar) to ensure text readability.

action_shot_1.description: People playing volleyball on outdoor court
action_shot_1.usage: Use for feature sections, 'Crear Torneo Rápido' or 'Crear Liga' card backgrounds.

action_shot_2.description: Man in white shorts playing volleyball
action_shot_2.usage: Secondary feature image or about section.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: All cards and buttons must have distinct hover states. Cards slightly lift. Buttons get brighter.
motion_and_interaction.drag_and_drop: Draggable elements should have cursor-grab, on drag active cursor-grabbing and a slight rotation (rotate-2) + shadow-lg.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure white text on primary sky-blue has enough contrast. If not, use a darker blue for the primary background.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, drag items) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='create-league-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install @hello-pangea/dnd for the Spotify-style timeline drag and drop editor.
Install date-fns for date manipulation in the league wizard.
Ensure the Landing Page has two massive, highly visible call-to-action buttons for 'Crear Liga' and 'Crear Torneo Rápido'.
In the Dashboard, use Shadcn UI customized with soft rounded-2xl edges to feel tactile.
The timeline drag & drop must represent 'Canchas' (Courts) as horizontal lanes, and 'Partidos' (Matches) as draggable pills with start/end times.
Use standard HTML inputs customized with Tailwind for wizards if Shadcn's react-hook-form integration is too rigid, but Shadcn forms are preferred.
The unified public search should filter through a single input both standings (tables) and matches.
For the 'Only Varonil / Only Femenil / Mixto' day selector, use segmented controls (Shadcn Tabs customized to look like a pill toggle).
